name: mushroomdb
description: Embedded graph database with incremental association rules and a built-in MCP stdio server for AI agents.
tools_note: Every tool here is callable. A default `tools/list` advertises eleven of them — the eight repository tools plus query, ingest_json and stats — because the other schemas cost more than a coding agent gets back. Run `mushroomdb mcp <db> --all-tools` to advertise this whole list.
